content: {"summary":"Customers report frustrating account‑name changes and long hold times, citing a 4‑day, 3‑call ordeal that left the wrong last name on their SkyMiles profile [tk_2580965]. Flight mileage credit gaps are common, with users missing partner leg miles and unsure if MQDs count before flying, leading to status‑deferment questions and delayed MQM postings [tk_446151][tk_2646472][tk_660653]. Technical issues with password reset and account creation for children hinder access, especially for password‑manager users [tk_1158704][tk_2094948]. Finally, redemption problems—no gift‑card options and uncredited mileage boosters—cause frustration and demand clearer guidance [tk_950383][tk_2151852]."}
